description: This Java class 'ShopizerClientsProperties' is a configuration properties holder used within a Spring Boot application to configure client settings for downstream services such as 'cart' and 'order'. It uses validation annotations to enforce constraints on properties like 'baseUrl' and 'timeoutMs'.

classes.name: ShopizerClientsProperties
classes.description: Main configuration class holding client properties for downstream services, with nested class 'ServiceClientProperties' for individual service settings.

classes.name: ServiceClientProperties
classes.description: Nested class representing configuration settings such as 'baseUrl' and 'timeoutMs' for a specific service client.

methods.name: getCart
methods.description: Returns the configuration properties for the cart service client.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the configuration properties for the order service client.

methods.name: getBaseUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the base URL for the service client.

methods.name: setBaseUrl
methods.description: Sets the base URL for the service client.

methods.name: getTimeoutMs
methods.description: Retrieves the timeout in milliseconds for the service client.

methods.name: setTimeoutMs
methods.description: Sets the timeout in milliseconds for the service client.
